lines.plainText: Take that and that Stabs him If all this will not do

lines.text: I'll drown you in the malmsey-butt within.
lines.plainText: I'll drown you in the malmseybutt within

lines.text: A bloody deed, and desperately dispatched.
lines.plainText: A bloody deed and desperately dispatched

lines.text: How fain, like Pilate, would I wash my hands
lines.plainText: How fain like Pilate would I wash my hands

lines.text: Of this most grievous murder.
lines.plainText: Of this most grievous murder

lines.text: How now? What mean'st thou that thou help'st me not?
lines.plainText: How now What mean'st thou that thou help'st me not

lines.text: By heavens, the Duke shall know how slack you have been.
lines.plainText: By heavens the Duke shall know how slack you have been

lines.text: I would he knew that I had saved his brother.
lines.plainText: I would he knew that I had saved his brother

lines.text: Take thou the fee, and tell him what I say,
lines.plainText: Take thou the fee and tell him what I say

lines.text: For I repent me that the Duke is slain.
lines.plainText: For I repent me that the Duke is slain

lines.text: So do not I. Go, coward as thou art.
lines.plainText: So do not I Go coward as thou art

lines.text: Well, I'll go hide the body in some hole
lines.plainText: Well I'll go hide the body in some hole

lines.text: Till that the Duke give order for his burial.
lines.plainText: Till that the Duke give order for his burial

lines.text: And when I have my meed, I will away,
lines.plainText: And when I have my meed I will away

lines.text: For this will out, and then I must not stay.
